Women's Asian Champions Trophy Hockey Begins in Bhopal

The Women's Asian Champions Trophy hockey tournament commenced in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav inaugurated the event and cheered for the Indian team. In the opening match, India defeated Malaysia with a score of 4-1.
